impact_assessment.benefits: A documented guideline, approved brand media, AL-1.1 license files, recorded topics and an AIKit-verified publish path.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Run media review/apply, license set, topics review/apply, add G-001, then publish only with python aikit.py publish.

[1/3] Plan: expose Shooter's four unrepresented data tables as read-only content surfaces and add Keystone's octahedron sample mesh to the generated asset pack

impact_assessment.why: Foundry currently reads only enemies/weapons/levels from Shooter and generates only cube/plane/crystal for Keystone, so real authored content from both projects stays outside the pipeline
impact_assessment.benefits: Shooter manifests cover engagement, grade, juice and core material graph; Keystone pack gains a fourth deterministic mesh with a failing-first test
impact_assessment.risks: contract: target manifest shape and pack manifest shape change; dependency: adapters read sibling files at import time; concurrency: none; state: checked-in manifests and pack must be regenerated byte-identically
impact_assessment.mitigation: add tests first, reuse existing generator APIs, validate manifests and pack with existing validators, and keep all source projects unmodified

[1/5] Plan: define a generic versioned game-asset pack format and consumer-side install path, covering the asset kinds games actually author, with Shooter as the first consumer

impact_assessment.why: Foundry's purpose is faster game creation through reusable assets, but today packs are engine-specific and no generic install hook exists outside crypt-crawler
impact_assessment.benefits: one validated pack can be installed into any new game in minutes; material/state/camera-path assets become reusable instead of game-local
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new pack schema and versioning affect existing Keystone pack; dependency: consumer projects may be absent; concurrency: installer must be idempotent; state: installed files must be digest-verified and never silently overwritten
impact_assessment.mitigation: keep the existing Keystone pack v1 untouched, add a new schema/version, drive everything from failing-first tests, and prove install into a temp scaffold before touching any game
